name: tristan-underhanded-levelup-enter-agility
notes: Tristan, Underhanded (bjlwabipl6): "On Enter: You may put a preparation counter on Tristan. If you don't, you gain agility 3 for this turn." Same real level-up as tristan-underhanded-levelup-enter-prep-counter, but the YES/NO is answered NO: GainAgility($player, 3) adds the AGILITY_3 global effect (the beginning-of-end-phase memory-return itself is the shared agility mechanism, already covered by nimble-court-assassin-enter-agility) and no preparation counter is put on Tristan.

rulesClauses: On Enter: If you do not put a preparation counter on Tristan, you gain agility 3 for this turn.
